_purpose: Pre-registered labelled question set for calibrating the retrieval similarity floor. Written and COMMITTED before any retrieval score was observed. The git history of this file is the pre-registration: if it were authored after seeing the score distributions, the chosen threshold would be a curve fit rather than a measurement, and every downstream eval case would be self-confirming.
_rules: Questions are NOT added, removed or reworded after scores are observed.
A genuinely wrong entry is corrected only via an explicit `revisions` entry recording what changed, why, and that it happened post-hoc; the calibration is then re-run from scratch and re-reported.
`supported` means the answer demonstrably exists in the 20-episode curated corpus; `expected_source_id` names the episode slug that should supply it.

`unsupported` splits into `near_miss` (plausibly on-topic growth/product questions the corpus does not cover) and `off_domain` (unrelated subjects). Near-miss is the honest test; off-domain alone would make any threshold look good.
